prompt:
Create an animated pop-up book entirely in code: no image generators, no downloaded art, no browser. Use Python with Skia and numpy to draw every frame, pipe the frames into ffmpeg, and synthesise all the sound in code too.
The scene: "Río de la Luna", a rainforest gorge whose river pours out of a full moon. Include:
•karst towers
•a rope bridge with three tiny travellers
•a kapok tree with monkeys and a toucan
•a temple ruin with pilgrims and lanterns
•a heron, and a canoe on a pull-tab
•mist, and birds
The beat (about 10 s, 1920×1080, 30 fps):
1An open atlas rests on a desk, showing a flat map of the valley.
2A thin page turns with a real paper curl.
3The board opens and the pop-up rises with real paper engineering. Use V-folds and layers on tabs, with the opening angle of the page driving every fold. Pieces lock upright with a soft spring.
4Life switches on: the river flows, birds lift off, the canoe slides on its tab, mist rises, lanterns glow.
5Slow push-in and hold on the finished scene.
Render the same scene in five art styles, each with its own animation feel:
1Cut-paper diorama under a warm desk lamp, with real soft cast shadows and fibred paper. Springy pop.
2Risograph pop-up in three spot inks: yellow, fluorescent pink and blue. It prints one ink pass at a time while you watch, in stop-motion on twos.
3Naturalist's field atlas: a pen-and-pencil drawing stands up first, then watercolour floods in from back to front. Slow bloom.
4Night lantern atlas: luminous inks on indigo paper. The moon is a real light source; light runs down the waterfall, lanterns catch one by one, fireflies rise. Floaty.
5Gilded engraver's atlas: hand-coloured copperplate with jewel washes, a gold-leaf moon with a moving sheen, and an oxblood leather binding. Stately, no bounce.
Sound: synthesised paper foley (a rustle on the page turn, little snaps as pieces lock open) over a soft jungle ambience.
The edit: cut the five styles into one montage with no titles. Start each style once its pop-up is already rising. End on a fast relay that cuts between all five styles every 0.4 s at the same moment of the animation, so the art style changes while the motion carries on.
Tone: vivid, tactile, calm and ASMR-satisfying, with a dreamlike touch. Nothing cluttered or chaotic.
